logs.subject: GHSA-h4pw-wj8w-qh2h: SAML Validation Contract Bypass (NaN Timestamp Comparison, CDATA Differential & Missing Multi-Element Checks)
logs.summary: Filed private GitHub Security Advisory GHSA-h4pw-wj8w-qh2h directly on stytchauth/samlshield detailing the unchecked Date.parse NaN expiration bypass (src/validate.ts:994-1021), CDATA_SECTION_NODE parser differential (src/validate.ts:140-152), and missing liberal.length checks.

logs.subject: [Responsible Disclosure] Two High-Severity Vulnerabilities in vercel-labs/skills (Symlink File Disclosure & Git Option Injection)
logs.summary: Privately disclosed ZB-2026-001 (Arbitrary Host File Disclosure via dereference: true Symlink Following in src/installer.ts:542-563 & src/use.ts:577-610) and ZB-2026-002 (Git Option Injection via disabled simple-git safety guards & missing '--' in src/git.ts:289-307 & src/update.ts:881) to Vercel Security per https://vercel.com/.well-known/security.txt, with defensive remediation patches.
